## Methods

### `FocusAsync()`

Sets keyboard focus to the toggle button element.
Returns: `ValueTask`.

### `SetToggledAsync(bool toggled)`

Sets the selected state programmatically. No-op when disabled or already in that state; inside a group it routes through the group so the group's binding stays authoritative.
Returns: `Task`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggled` | `bool` | The state to move to. |

### `Toggle()`

Toggles the selected state, exactly as a user click would (honors the disabled state and, inside a group, the group's selection rules).
Returns: `Task`.
